title: I Tap a Tin Pan
lines: I am Tim. I tap a tin pan.
Nan and Pip nap. It is a nap mat.
I sit. I fan Nan and Pip.
I nap as Nan and Pip nap.

questions.listenFor: A tin pan. The first line says it. Ask them what a tin pan would sound like.

questions.ask: What does Tim do when he sees Nan and Pip napping?
questions.listenFor: He sits down — he stops tapping — and fans them. Line four says it. Listen for them linking the napping to the stopping; that is the whole story.

questions.ask: What do you do to stay quiet when someone at home is asleep? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea — tiptoe, whisper, shut the door, go to another room.
